data.name: Superstition
data.description: You gain a +%1 morale bonus on saving throws made to resist spells, supernatural abilities, and spell-like abilities. While raging, you cannot be a willing target of any spell and must make saving throws to resist all spells, even those cast by allies.|SuperstitionSaveBonus
